top_signal.title: I have 19,000 brand-new 9.5” x 12” bubble mailers. Where would you recommend selling/liquidating them?
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone! I’m looking for some advice on where I could sell a  large quantity of bubble mailers in the San Francisco/Bay Area .  I have approximately  19,000 brand-new bubble mailers , each measuring  9.5" x 12"  They are padded/bubble envelopes and have a  logo printed on them .   They were originally purchased for a business, but I no longer need them and would rather sell them in bulk to someone who can actually use them.   Does anyone know of  fulfillment companies, e-commerce businesses, packaging companies, small businesses, shipping/mail centers, resellers, or other businesses in San Francisco/the Bay Area  that might be interested in purchasing something like this?   I’d really appreciate recommendations on  who I should contact or what type of company would buy this kind of inventory . Thanks!       submitted by     /u/pathfinderbaby       [link]       [comments]
